locator: The whole print: the street front of 2033 square-on from the far walk of Prairie Avenue, from the cornice to the public walk; the vacant lot and a concrete loft to the north, a later tower to the south.
rights_note: A 1946 photograph by Walker Evans that the Art Institute of Chicago lists as not in the public domain (AIC API: is_public_domain false); the Prairie library rules it 'copyright - link only'. Only forms, counts, places and proportions are read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset (no texture, no traced mesh), and the copy committed for the image gate (T-3659) is the image store's, unaltered, with its attribution in the folder's README.

note: The one picture of 2033 Prairie this project reads, and it is late: 1946, after both neighbours of the row had gone. A narrow three-storey front of pale stone laid in channelled courses, the whole lot's 25 ft wide, over a raised basement: a full-height three-sided bay on the south two-thirds, one light to each face of it a storey, with a heavy moulded band at each storey's sill; the north third with the double door at the head of a long straight stoop under a pedimented hood on two scrolled consoles with an urn on its apex, and one light a storey over it under a carved keystone block; every light arched; a deep bracketed cornice over a carved frieze carried round the bay; an arched light in the basement under the bay; an iron picket fence on a curb along the walk. The Otis family lived here from 1869 to 1934, so the front is read as the 1904 front unless a picture of nearer date says otherwise: its forms are carried to 1904 as inferred.
what_it_supplies: the front's width, its storeys and its heights, through the solved camera
the bay: its place, its three faces, its lights and its storey bands
the door, its hood, the stoop and its run to the walk
the lights over the door, their arched heads and keystone blocks
the cornice, the frieze, the basement light and the fence
what_it_does_not_supply: the flanks, the rear, the roof and the rear range
